content.text: Maimae thaonae Cathut koe kacaipounglah la sak awh.
Jakop Cathut koe konawm laihoi hram awh.
La sak awh nateh cecak hah khawng awh.
A lawk kahawi e ratoung tamawi hah kueng awh.
Thapa rei hnin, kamhluem hnin,
pawi hnin vah mongka ueng awh.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, hethateh,
Isarelnaw hanlah phunglam lah ao teh,
Jakop Cathut kâlawk lah ao.
Hethateh, Izip ram pueng a cei awh teh,
thai panuek hoeh e lawk thainae hmuen koevah,
lawkpanuesaknae Joseph koe a sak e doeh.
A loung dawk a hrawm e hnori hah a puen pouh teh,
a kut hoi a tawm e a bawm hah a kuem pouh.
Rucat navah na kaw teh na rungngang awh.
khoparitnae hmuen koehoi na pato awh teh,
Meribah tui koehoi na tanouk awh. Selah.
Oe ka taminaw thai awh haw,
lawk na thui vai.
Oe Isarel ka lawk tarawi awh haw.
Miphun louk cathut nangmouh koe awm mahoeh.
Miphun louk cathut na bawk awh mahoeh.
Kai teh Cathut Jehovah,
Izip ram hoi na kahrawikung doeh.
Ka kaw lah na pahni ang awh nateh, ka kawi sak han.
Hatei, ka taminaw ni ka lawk hah ngai awh hoeh.
Isarelnaw ni banglahai na pouk awh hoeh.
Amamae lungpatanae koe ka poe teh,
amamouh ngai patetlah ao awh.
Oe ka taminaw ni ka lawk hah ngai boilah,
Isarel ni ka lamthung dawn haw pawiteh khe.
A taran tang ka tâ pouh vaiteh,
ahnimouh katarankungnaw koe
ka kut ka dâw pouh han eite.
BAWIPA kahmuhmanaw ni
a hmalah kâhet awh vaiteh,
ka taminaw teh pou a kangning awh han eite.
Kahawi poung e tavai hoi ka kawk vaiteh,
lungsong thung e khoitui hoi a lungkhuekti sak han eite.
